artist.name: Varun Desai
artist.bio: Varun Desai is a Kolkata-based DJ, producer, label head and educator who records as Yidam and 5volts. He started the label Liquid Frequency, which releases electronic and ambient music by Indian acts, set up the Social Isolation ambient compilations during lockdown, and runs the synthesizer residency Synthfarm. On boxout.fm he hosted Tropickle, a show of South American sounds, Bengali folk and electro-cumbia.
